events.selectedSentence: Richmond enter 10th and Geelong Cats 3rd; a late-season contest carrying finals-position pressure.
events.fullSpiel: Richmond are 10th with 16 points, while Geelong Cats are 3rd with 24. That makes this more than a date in Round 8: it is a late-season contest carrying finals-position pressure, with the next chapter shaped by the separation they create or erase.
